title: CARTE: A Benchmark for Mapping Language Model Knowledge Across France

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on CARTE, a multiple-choice benchmark of 2,431 questions covering 14 thematic domains to assess fine-grained, region-specific cultural and socio-economic knowledge across the 13 metropolitan regions of France.

Evaluating model performance on CARTE-LV, a multiple-choice subset targeting regional linguistic variations, to identify performance disparities regarding vocabulary, expressions, grammar, and pragmatics specific to different French regions.

Calculating a Bias Score derived from Normalized Shannon Entropy to evaluate whether a language model exhibits a systemic preference for specific multiple-choice answer positions (e.g., constantly choosing option A, B, C, D, or E).
